name: drawio-tools
description: Create, inspect, edit, open, and export editable draw.io diagrams through a pinned official MCP runtime.

interface.longDescription: Draw.io Tools provides the official draw.io MCP tool surface from a setup-time verified offline runtime, plus optional draw.io Desktop export to editable PNG, SVG, and PDF artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Use $drawio to create an editable multi-page architecture diagram and open it in draw.io.
Use $drawio to edit this .drawio file and export an editable SVG or PDF.
